typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ORDERNUM as integer,
		REPORTING_FIELD as string,
		APPROVALS_NY as integer,
		APPROVALS_WNY as integer,
		DENIALS_NY as integer,
		DENIALS_WNY as integer,
		PARTIAL_NY as integer,
		PARTIAL_WNY as integer,
		TOTAL as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	CL.CALLLIST_CD AS CALL_LIST_CD, 	CL.CALLLIST_NAME AS CALL_LIST_NAME, 	CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) REPORT_DATE, 	M.MEMBER_MCAID_MARKET_CD AS MARKET_CD, 	M.MEMBER_MCAID_PRODUCT_CD AS PRODUCT_CD, 	UJ.UNITJOB_NAME AS UNIT_JOB, 	M.MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION, 	M.MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE, 	COUNT(CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID) AS [MEMBERS LOADED], 	SUM(CASE WHEN CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [MEMBERS SCRUBBED], 	SUM(CASE WHEN CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [MEMBERS TO DIALER] FROM [dbo].[PDS_RPT_DMCCU_SCRUBLIST_MEMBERS] T 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON T.MAX_CM_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON T.MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST CL ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_RPT_UNITJOB UJ ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID = UJ.UNITJOB_IID GROUP BY CL.CALLLIST_CD,CL.CALLLIST_NAME,CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END),M.MEMBER_MCAID_MARKET_CD,M.MEMBER_MCAID_PRODUCT_CD,UJ.UNITJOB_NAME,M.MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION,M.MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE ORDER BY UJ.UNITJOB_NAME,M.MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION,M.MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ProviderData
ProviderData derive(REPORTING_FIELD_Unicode = toString(REPORTING_FIELD)) ~> DataConversion
